scripts.dev:infra: docker compose up -d cabinet-db dsp-db dsp
scripts.dev:cabinet: npm run dev:infra && docker compose stop cabinet && npm run dev --workspace=apps/cabinet -- --hostname 127.0.0.1 --port 3000
scripts.dev:auction: npm run dev:infra && docker compose stop auction && npm run dev --workspace=apps/auction -- --hostname 127.0.0.1 --port 3001
scripts.test: npm run test:startup && npm run test:smoke
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=apps/cabinet && npm run typecheck --workspace=apps/auction
